drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins and Middle East refinery strikes
Petcoke rally narrowing discount to coal
Price down 16% in 3 months; some coker restarts
outlooks.summary: Supply headlines lean mildly bullish (Gulf shut-ins, Saudi attacks, US refinery outages), but the score is weak (+0.09) and restarts offset part of it. The price has already fallen 16% in three months, so the signal is unclear.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how fast US Gulf output returns after the storm and whether the Saudi refinery and terminal disruptions last.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应类新闻略偏利多(墨西哥湾停产、沙特炼厂遭袭、美国炼厂故障),但综合得分仅+0.09,且部分焦化装置已重启,抵消了一部分影响。价格三个月已下跌16%,整体信号不明确。
drivers_zh: 墨西哥湾停产及中东炼厂遭袭
石油焦价格上涨,与煤炭的价差收窄
三个月价格下跌16%,部分焦化装置重启
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注风暴后美国墨西哥湾产量恢复速度,以及沙特炼厂和码头的中断是否持续。

drivers: Fed rate hike fears and strong dollar
ETF outflows and fading central bank buying
outlooks.summary: Gold is not a supply story. Headlines point to macro-driven selling, with no supply shortage that could lift prices. There are no supply headlines, so shortage-driven upside is unlikely.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed policy signals and ETF flows.
outlooks.summary_zh: 黄金并非供应驱动型品种。新闻显示价格受宏观因素压制抛售,没有可能推高价格的供应短缺,也没有供应类新闻,因此由短缺引发上涨的可能性较低。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
ETF资金流出,央行购金减弱
价格处于14个月低位
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美联储下一步政策信号及ETF资金流向。

drivers: Congo export quotas halving Glencore output
outlooks.summary: Congo quotas are cutting output sharply and the market is described as tightening. The price has dropped 24% in three months, so the shortage may not be fully priced in, though it is up 26% on the year.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo quota allocations and export shipment volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果配额大幅削减产量,市场被描述为趋紧。价格三个月下跌24%,短缺可能尚未完全反映,但年内仍上涨26%。
drivers_zh: 刚果出口配额使嘉能可产量减半
出口管制令市场趋紧
价格三个月已下跌24%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果配额分配及出口发运量。

outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly indirect (copper output weakness, general export rules) with no molybdenum-specific shortage news. The price has already risen 18% in three months, so more upside is unclear.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chilean copper mine output, since molybdenum is a by-product.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为间接信息(铜产量疲弱、一般性出口政策),没有钼的专门短缺消息。价格三个月已上涨18%,进一步上行空间不明确。
drivers_zh: 智利铜产量接近23年低点
一般性出口政策与污染类新闻
价格三个月上涨18%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注智利铜矿产量,因为钼为铜的副产品。

drivers: Zimbabwe export tax and 2027 export ban plans
Price up 71% in 12 months, down 13% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe's policy tightening is mildly bullish, but the ban is for 2027 and miners are seeking a delay. The score is modest (+0.20) and the price is already high.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Zimbabwe delays or confirms the 2027 export ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦政策收紧略偏利多,但禁令针对2027年,且矿商正寻求推迟。综合得分不高(+0.20),价格已处高位。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦出口税及2027年出口禁令计划
本地采购要求
价格12个月上涨71%,三个月下跌13%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦是推迟还是确认2027年出口禁令。

drivers: Laos rare earth operations suspended after dam breach
China export controls suspended only to Jan 2027
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages and the Laos suspension add to tightness, and Chinese controls could return after the suspension ends. The price is up only 4% in three months, so the risk is not fully priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the January 2027 expiry of China's export control suspension and Laos output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 钇短缺和老挝停产加剧供应紧张,中国出口管制暂停期结束后可能恢复。价格三个月仅上涨4%,风险可能尚未充分反映。
drivers_zh: 钇供应停滞
老挝溃坝后稀土作业被暂停
中国出口管制仅暂停至2027年1月
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注2027年1月中国出口管制暂停到期及老挝产量。

outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts are tightening supply, and the supply-pressure score is the highest of the group (+0.39). Price is up strongly over 12 months but flat over three, so some of the risk may be priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and Congo mine disruptions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产使供应趋紧,供应压力得分较高(+0.39)。价格12个月涨幅明显,但三个月持平,部分风险可能已被反映。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突与印尼减产
芯片供应紧张
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量及刚果矿山中断情况。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China's US export ban suspension nearing expiry
outlooks.summary: A major Chinese mine halt and the possible return of export bans point to tighter supply. The price is well below last year's level, leaving room for a rebound.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for the expiry of China's export ban suspension and how long the mine stays shut.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产,且出口禁令可能恢复,供应面趋紧。价格远低于去年水平,存在反弹空间。
drivers_zh: 中国大型锑矿停产
中国对美出口禁令暂停即将到期
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口禁令暂停到期情况及该矿停产时长。

outlooks.summary: Export controls keep supply tight and alternatives are still being funded, so shortages persist. However, the price has already jumped 67% in three months, so much of this may be priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for any change in Chinese export licensing and new ex-China projects.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制使供应持续紧张,非中国供应仍在筹资阶段,短缺将延续。但价格三个月已大涨67%,部分利多可能已被消化。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制产生影响
各国政府资助非中国供应
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口许可变化及非中国新项目进展。

drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins and Middle East refinery strikes
Petcoke rally narrowing discount to coal
outlooks.summary: Supply headlines are mildly bullish but the score is weak (+0.09) and restarts offset part of it. Price is up 15% in three months, so some of the risk may be priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf output recovery and the duration of Saudi refinery disruptions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应类新闻略偏利多,但得分较弱(+0.09),且装置重启抵消了部分影响。价格三个月上涨15%,部分风险可能已被反映。
drivers_zh: 墨西哥湾停产及中东炼厂遭袭
石油焦价格上涨,与煤炭的价差收窄
部分焦化装置重启
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾产量恢复及沙特炼厂中断的持续时间。

drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins and Middle East refinery strikes
Petcoke rally narrowing discount to coal
outlooks.summary: Headlines mix outages with restarts and the score is weak (+0.09). The index is down 5% in three months but up 46% on the year, so the signal is unclear.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery restarts in the US Gulf and Middle East supply disruptions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻中既有停产也有重启,得分较弱(+0.09)。指数三个月下跌5%,但年内上涨46%,信号不明确。
drivers_zh: 墨西哥湾停产及中东炼厂遭袭
石油焦价格上涨,与煤炭的价差收窄
炼厂重启
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾炼厂重启及中东供应中断情况。
